title: Espresso brewing guide
scope: One conventional pump-machine shot on a Breville Bambino Plus BES500 with the supplied 54 mm two-cup single-wall unpressurized basket; pressurized, lever and portable equipment remain contextual variants.

sources.title: The Bambino Plus BES500 instruction book, USCM T23
supports: Supplied two-cup basket 16-19 g; single versus dual wall; Razor clearance check; PID and pre-infusion; button start/stop; hot-pressure safety and model-specific maintenance.

sources.title: Quick + Easy Espresso
sources.author_or_organization: Counter Culture Coffee, Jenna, National Wholesale Education Manager
supports: Published 18 g dose, 36 g cup yield and 25-35 second comparison; even distribution, level tamp and taste-based adjustment. Clock origin is not stated.

sources.title: Espresso Recipes: Time
supports: Pump-start to pump-stop convention; dose then yield then time; time advisory relative to target yield; finer does not indefinitely improve extraction.

sources.title: Barista One B1 3.02 - Channelling
supports: Uneven distribution and tamp cause uneven flow; strong channels can produce spraying or watery turbulent flow.

sources.title: Encore ESP Operations Manual, January 2023 v1.0
supports: Setting 15 is a starting point for 18 g medium-roast espresso; dose, roast, recipe and grinder shim configuration affect applicability.

sources.title: Flair 58 Quick Start Guide, after May 2023, linked by manufacturer tutorials
supports: Lever-specific preheating, manually filling the cylinder, pressure gauge and lever operation, and expelling remaining water before removal; pump workflow is not universal.

sources.title: Picopresso manufacturer product and operation description
supports: Portable manually pumped espresso; the brewer does not heat water. No portable safety procedure is inferred from the pump-machine guide.

sources.title: Older Flair 58 manual URL
supports: No claims: direct fetch returned 404; replaced by the manufacturer's currently linked guide.

sources.title: How to clean portafilter and filter basket, Bambino Plus
supports: No claims: fetch failed on both original and inspiration host; maintenance is evidenced by the verified instruction book.

recipe.name: Bambino Plus measured 18 g to 36 g beginner adaptation
equipment: Supplied 54 mm two-cup single-wall unpressurized basket, specified 16-19 g
Compatible tamper and Razor dose tool
Scale reading 0.1 g, cup and timer
recipe.grind_description: Espresso-fine; dial by measured yield, flow and taste rather than a universal powder texture or grinder number.

expected_time_s.clock_start: Pump begins when the shot is started; include the factory pre-infusion. This is our explicit convention; Counter Culture does not state its clock origin.
expected_time_s.clock_end: Pump stops at the selected beverage mass; record settled cup mass separately if drips continue.

recipe.preinfusion_control: Leave factory pre-infusion unchanged; duration is not verified or invented.
recipe.completion_signal: Stop pump so settled yield approaches twice the actual dose: 36 g for 18 g. After trimming, keep dose within 16-19 g or reprepare. If the preset stops first, record the result without restarting that shot. Yield and taste own the endpoint, not a mandatory time stop or blonding alone.

steps.instruction: Complete first-use setup, seat a filled potable-water tank and drip tray, and wait for ready lights.
steps.completion: Machine ready on a stable dry counter.

steps.instruction: Fit the specified single-wall basket and warm and dry the portafilter as directed.
steps.why: Use the intended basket and repeatable starting condition.
steps.completion: Clean dry basket ready for grounds.

steps.instruction: Tare the empty portafilter, grind and weigh 18 g of grounds, distribute evenly, then tamp level and firmly.
steps.why: Measure actual grounds; even resistance reduces preferential flow.

steps.instruction: Apply the Razor clearance check, reweigh after trimming, and keep actual dose within 16-19 g; otherwise reprepare. Clear the rim, briefly flush, and lock in securely. Target twice actual dose.
steps.why: Respect basket fit and maintain the chosen output ratio.
steps.completion: Portafilter secure without forcing; actual dose and matching yield recorded.

steps.instruction: Tare the cup on the scale. Press 2 CUP and start the timer with pump start; retain factory pre-infusion.
steps.why: Track beverage mass with an explicit clock.
steps.completion: Pump running and mass accumulating; clock includes pre-infusion.

steps.instruction: Press the running shot button at twice actual dose: 36 g for 18 g. Record pump-stop time and settled yield, then taste when cool enough. If the preset stops first, record without restarting; use manual or programmed-shot instructions next brew.
steps.why: Yield precedes advisory time; a preset stop is not a reason to restart the same extraction.
steps.completion: Pump stopped; recorded cup yield compared with the selected target.

steps.instruction: Stop and let flow settle before opening. If pressure or blockage is suspected, leave locked, switch off, cool and contact Breville if unresolved. Remove grounds and clean as directed.
steps.why: Hot pressurized parts require the correct procedure.
steps.completion: Equipment safely cleaned; switched off, unplugged and cooled for further maintenance.

variants.name: Dual-wall pressurized basket
variants.how_it_differs: Basket restriction changes flow interpretation and permits preground coffee; use the machine's matching basket and dosing instructions.

variants.name: Flair 58 lever
variants.how_it_differs: Separate preheat, manual cylinder fill, lever/gauge control and purge sequence; use its own start convention and pressure-release procedure.

variants.name: Picopresso portable
variants.how_it_differs: Requires externally heated water and manual pumping; pump-machine button and warmup steps do not apply. Consult its manual before opening.

variants.name: Different basket or multiple drinks
variants.how_it_differs: Revalidate compatible dose and headspace; two separate shots are the beginner way to serve twice this recipe.

troubleshooting.symptom: Spraying, irregular watery flow or unstable results
troubleshooting.check_first: Distribution, level tamp, basket fit and clean rim; visible flow cannot exclude every small channel.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Repeat consistent preparation before grinding finer; then change one variable.

troubleshooting.symptom: Consistently fast, thin or sharply sour
troubleshooting.check_first: Actual dose and output mass are correct; preparation is repeatable.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try slightly finer grind at the same dose and yield; taste again. Yield can later be adjusted separately.

troubleshooting.check_first: Rule out irregular preparation and blockage.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try slightly coarser grind while retaining comparison dose and yield.

troubleshooting.check_first: Stop; verify seated water tank, basket cleanliness and dose clearance before another shot.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Correct equipment state; use a slightly coarser grind only once those checks pass.

safety: Never unlock during extraction. Stop and let flow settle. If pressure or blockage is suspected, leave locked, switch off, cool and contact Breville if unresolved.
Keep clear of hot metal, water and steam; use handles.
Switch off, unplug and cool before maintenance; never immerse the machine.
Use model-specific cleaning and descaling procedures.

app_audit.finding: Espresso already defaults to ratio 2, BEVERAGE_YIELD, 25-35 seconds, no bloom/pulses, null capacity, zero absorption and no decaf time adjustment.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve the correct output semantics; a basket-scoped guide may enrich current defaults without claiming the ratio is missing.

app_audit.finding: WATER_IN is unavailable for espresso, while IN_CUP is available. CalculatorRatioOptions.kt already offers espresso ratios 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Keep quantity and ratio ownership intact.

app_audit.finding: DirectTargetBeverageYield converts legacy state.waterG into targetBeverageYieldG with dry-dose/beverage-yield ratio roles; it does not populate brewWaterInputG. BeverageOutputEstimator.kt deliberately returns null for espresso.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve typed quantity roles; do not add a retention coefficient or reservoir estimate for espresso.

app_audit.finding: RecipeSection always labels state.waterG as label_water, although it means collected espresso mass. It also always renders the enum's 90-94 C band without model-control context.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Render beverage-yield mass for espresso and explain temperature only where the actual machine offers brew control.

app_audit.finding: Non-bloom active timers auto-start on screen entry. Espresso therefore has no established pump-start or first-drip measurement origin in this legacy screen.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Align an explicit start action with the chosen clock; include pre-infusion and distinguish it from first-drip clocks.

app_audit.finding: instruction_espresso_stop says stop at target yield or when the shot blondes; BrewTimerScreen.methodTimerGuidanceRes selects it once the low time target is reached. Typed LegacyBuiltInGuidanceCatalog already says selected beverage target.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Use selected yield as the normal stop cue and treat time/stream color as observations. Preserve the already-correct typed guidance.

app_audit.finding: Typed espresso uses one manual OBSERVE stage, avoiding automatic completion from the short time range. BrewingCatalog models pump, lever and portable as separate profiles; basket pressurised status is unknown for generic baskets.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve manual completion; any named hardware guide should carry its actual basket and operating constraints. BuiltInP1RecipeCatalog/P1ExactGuidanceFactualErrata contain no espresso exact recipe or espresso erratum, and the 2026-08-19 factual audit does not cover espresso.

app_audit.finding: VERY_FINE, used by espresso fallback, says Like powdered sugar. The model-specific asset has separate ESP settings and should not be replaced by a universal dial value.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Prefer espresso-fine guidance tied to flow and taste; texture alone does not establish a working espresso setting.

app_audit.finding: Encore ESP has rangeStart=rangeEnd=suggestedStart=15, specifically an 18 g medium-roast manufacturer starting point. C40 7-13 and Niche Zero 10-20 are model-scoped; their upstream pages were not reverified in this pass.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Retain the supported Encore ESP scope and calibration limitations; do not promise guaranteed flow from setting 15 or silently generalize it.

app_audit.finding: Decaf metadata asserts universal coarser adjustments plus exact roast/process step modifiers. No primary evidence for those fixed espresso modifiers was verified here.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Keep those modifiers out of this researched recipe; review exact model and bean evidence separately before describing them as universal facts.

uncertainties: Counter Culture's published 25-35 seconds does not state clock origin; pump-start timing is our explicit adaptation.
Numeric Bambino brew-temperature setpoint, factory pre-infusion duration and a pressure-release wait were not verified; leave them null, and use model instructions.
The basket's 16-19 g specification does not guarantee every roast at 18 g fits; the clearance check may require a different measured dose and corresponding yield.
C40, Niche Zero and fixed decaf/roast/process modifiers were inspected in code but not independently revalidated against original sources.
The older Flair manual URL returned 404; its current manufacturer-linked guide was read. Breville cleanup tutorial access failed, so verified manual maintenance controls this guide.
No physical brewing, device execution, accessibility speech, translation approval or release validation occurred.
do_not_claim: Every espresso uses 9 bar, 18 g, 1:2 or a 30-second endpoint.
All double baskets fit this dose or pump-machine directions transfer to levers and portable brewers.
36 g beverage is 36 ml, reservoir fill, or the mass of water passing through the coffee.
The app still lacks espresso 1:2 beverage-yield semantics.
A fixed grinder number, decaf time shortcut, pre-infusion duration, retention coefficient or pressure-release wait works universally.
Blonding or an apparently even stream proves that the selected yield or extraction is correct.
